Name: Heightmap
Description: Loads an image as a terrain field. The red channel is sampled across the full terrain area and can be scaled, offset, or inverted before merging.

Params.Name: Heightmap
Params.Label: Heightmap
Params.Description: Image used as the terrain height field. The red channel is sampled as the height value.
Params.Tooltip: Click the preview to choose a heightmap image. The filter remains inactive until a valid image is selected.

Params.Name: MapScale
Params.Label: Map scale
Params.Description: Scales the imported heightmap in terrain space.
Params.Tooltip: Uniformly scales the heightmap on both axes. Values below 1 make a smaller placed patch.

Params.Name: MapPosition
Params.Label: Map position
Params.Description: Moves the heightmap center relative to the terrain center.
Params.Tooltip: Uses normalized terrain coordinates: 0,0 is centered and +/-1 moves by one terrain width or height.

Params.Name: MapRotation
Params.Label: Map rotation
Params.Description: Rotates the imported heightmap around its center in degrees.

Params.Name: EdgeFeather
Params.Label: Edge feather
Params.Description: Softens the transition between the imported patch and the existing terrain.
Params.Tooltip: Increase this when placing a smaller map to avoid a visible rectangular edge.

Params.Name: HeightScale
Params.Label: Height scale
Params.Description: Multiplies the sampled height values before merging them.
Params.Tooltip: Use this to increase, reduce, or reverse the heightmap amplitude.

Params.Name: HeightOffset
Params.Label: Height offset
Params.Description: Adds a constant offset to the sampled height values.
Params.Tooltip: Shifts the imported heightmap up or down before the merge stage.

Params.Name: FitToFieldRange
Params.Label: Fit to field range
Params.Description: Maps the imported normalized height into the current terrain min/max range before merging.

Params.Name: Invert
Params.Label: Invert heightmap
Params.Description: Reverses the sampled height values before scaling and offsetting.
